content.text: Epididymal pain & swelling thought to be 2/2 retrograde infect or reflux of urine –
▪︎acute epididymitis = MCC of scrotal pain; infectious or noninfectious
▪︎E. coli also w/ insertive anal intercourse; less common: Pseudomonas, Ureaplasma, M. genitalium
▪︎prepubertal: UTI, virus, M. pneumoniae (boys <14: postinfectious after M. pneumoniae resp infect)
▪︎tenderness over superior-posterior testis; scrotum may be erythematous
: relief of pain w/ scrotal elevation
: stroking of inner thigh → elevation of ipsilat testis
▪︎start empiric abx by STI risk while awaiting cx
▪︎low STI risk: levofloxacin 500mg PO qd x10d
▪︎⍉FQs (can't take) → TMP-SMX; nonsexually transmitted: E. coli & coliforms, Pseudomonas
▪︎insertive anal intercourse, obstructive uropathy, or recent urologic procedure → chlamydia/gonorrhea + enteric bacteria: ceftriaxone + FQ
▪︎prepubertal: tx UTI if present, supportive care
Peritoneal fluid between the parietal & visceral layers of the tunica vaginalis
Types: noncommunicating, communicating, hydrocele of the cord
Mass in the inguinal canal or scrotum; transilluminates on PE
, bed rest, scrotal support, cool packs
Prostate gland inflam 2/2 an ascending infect
▪︎RF: urinary cath, urogenital instrumentation, anatomic abnl (ex, urethral stricture), prostate BX
: hesitancy, poor or interrupted stream, straining to void, incomplete emptying
▪︎warm, edematous prostate; sacral or suprapubic pain; urinary retention; ⍉CVA tenderness (vs pyelo)
▪︎leukocytosis w/ Lt shift, hematuria; urine cx → guide abx; blood cx if signs of sepsis
▪︎hospitalized (comorbidities, sepsis): IV ampicillin + aminoglycoside (gentamicin); afebrile x48h → PO (TMP-SMX, cipro)
▪︎urinary retention: in-and-out cath or short-term indwelling cath
